title: Copper Handles
description: Adds copper handles that make your tools stronger and faster to repair!
body:
Copper Handles; the mod that makes tools better using copper!

**What does this mod do?**
This mod adds copper handles, that can upgrade your tools and increase their durability!

**Why should i get it?**
Not only it adds a use for copper, and the added durability to your tools is nice, considering you gain 1.5x more durability!

**Any extra things?**
The mod adds a Copper Station- essential for transforming your tools.
You can also repair them with copper, but watch out! Iron uses copper ingots, but diamond uses copper blocks!
It might also have new copper things in the future!
